title.en: An Act Converting the Foreshore of the Barrio of Navotas, Municipality of Calapan, Province of Oriental Mindoro, into a Tourist Resort to be Known as Navotas Tourist Resort
title.orig: An Act Converting the Foreshore of the Barrio of Navotas, Municipality of Calapan, Province of Oriental Mindoro, into a Tourist Resort to be Known as Navotas Tourist Resort

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_4024_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The foreshore of Barrio of Navotas, Municipality of Calapan, Province of Oriental Mindoro, is hereby converted into a tourist resort to be known as Navotas Tourist Resort.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1964.
